urls.rationale: Ch. 42.17 'Disclosure -- Campaign finances -- Lobbying' — the operative lobbying-disclosure chapter at vintage 2010 (the 42.17A consolidation enacted by 2010 c 204 had a January 1, 2012 effective date).

notes: Ch. 42.17A is also exposed at the 2009 title-42 page but it is the pre-staged post-reorg consolidation (effective Jan 1, 2012); at vintage 2010 the operative lobbying-disclosure body is Ch. 42.17. Exposed at pass-2 as a chapter directory page; pass-3 will pull individual section leaves (per-section convention, Wisconsin Example D shape — matches the WA 2015 bundle's shape, just on the pre-reorg chapter).
